definition_used: Used when an editor’s credentials are false/forged or when an editor subverts one or more processes under their purview. An “editor” may be an established editor affiliated with the journal or a guest editor.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes an editor subverting processes under their purview, which directly maps to editorial/peer review governance failures. The actor is explicitly the editor, and the process signals include editorial breach and compromised peer review.
